eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosed case of PCOS, ≥ 6-months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hyperprolactinemia, hypothyroidism, adrenal hyperplasia or Cushing's syndrome (on history \& medical record review)

identificationModule.briefTitle: Myo-Inositol and D-Chiro-Inositol for Menstrual Irregularities and Hormone Changes in Women With Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome
